evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that Yi-34B-Chat ranked second on the AlpacaEval Leaderboard as of January 2024, ahead of several other large language models and behind only GPT-4 Turbo.

identity.name: yi-34b-chat
identity.summary: The Yi series models are open-source large language models trained from scratch by 01.AI.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports only SFT and no grounding or factuality evaluation for a text-generation chat model, so plausible hallucination risk.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: The card states the model was trained from scratch by 01.AI as a large open-source LLM, implying substantial training compute/environmental cost.

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: The card provides only a brief model card with no documentation of governance or development process, making accountability harder to establish.

specifications.model_size: 64.1 GiB of safetensors weights (68,777,898,032 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The released chat model was trained exclusively with supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
